mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate remains persistently below its long-run average for at least three consecutive months, it reduces the real interest rate, encouraging equity investment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the 30-day moving average (t-test p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) coinciding with a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market strengthening, which typically precedes equity risk-on flows and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% month-over-month AND UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in the same month
failure_condition: During triggered months, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative and exceed the prior month's 20-day return by more than one standard deviation (z-score > 2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month trend, accompanied by rising consumer demand proxies (HOUST), predicts stronger economic momentum and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12-month trend for two consecutive months AND HOUST increases by >2% month-over-month
failure_condition: Over the 5-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant versus a no-signal baseline (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) suggests supply-side weakness, which often precedes equity risk-off and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >5% month-over-month AND CPIAUCSL falls by >0.5% month-over-month
regime_hint: Supply shock or soft landing risk
failure_condition: During the 20-day window, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from the prior 20-day average (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in CPIAUCSL above 2% above its prior month's value while FEDFUNDS remains unchanged signals unexpected inflation pressure, which typically precedes a preemptive rate hike and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > prior_month + 2% AND FEDFUNDS unchanged for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 60 days post-trigger, SPX 20-day forward returns remain positive and exceed the inflation surprise baseline by at least 1 standard deviation (z > 1.96).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in unemployment (UNRATE) without a corresponding rise in labor force participation (PAYEMS) suggests labor market tightening, which can increase risk aversion and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls by >0.3 percentage points for three consecutive months AND PAYEMS does not increase by >1% month-over-month
failure_condition: During the 20-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the prior 20-day average (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive month of falling consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) and rising retail sales proxies (HOUST) suggests demand is decoupling from cost pressures, which can sustain equity risk-on sentiment and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls by >0.3% month-over-month for two consecutive months AND HOUST increases by >1% month-over-month
failure_condition: Over the 5-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative and exceed the prior month's 20-day return by more than one standard deviation (z > 2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in both industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) simultaneously, without a preceding shock, is often interpreted as a supply-side soft landing, which can temporarily boost risk appetite and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month trend for two consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL falls by >0.4% month-over-month
failure_condition: During the 20-day window, SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant versus a neutral macro backdrop (p > 0.10).
